definition.en: The United Nations is an international organization founded in 1945 to maintain international peace and security, develop friendly relations among nations, and promote social progress and better standards of living.
definition.hi: The United Nations is an international organization founded in 1945 to maintain international peace and security, develop friendly relations among nations, and promote social progress and better standards of living.

importanceInUpsc.en: For UPSC GS-3, the UN is critical for understanding global economic governance, sustainable development goals (SDGs), and India's role in international economic forums. Questions often focus on how UN mandates influence domestic policy frameworks and international trade cooperation.
importanceInUpsc.hi: For UPSC GS-3, the UN is critical for understanding global economic governance, sustainable development goals (SDGs), and India's role in international economic forums. Questions often focus on how UN mandates influence domestic policy frameworks and international trade cooperation.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the economic mandate of the UN and its specialized agencies.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the economic mandate of the UN and its specialized agencies.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of UN-led development agendas on the Indian economy.
